item.guhs.vlieg_diploma.lore: For whoever flew the whole cloud-ring course of the Flying Dream. Without getting lost even once (well... almost).
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.omhoog: The Rookguh puffs up its little cheeks and floats you up... to the Flying Dream! Don't look down, vadsje.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.omlaag: Hop on its back! The Rookguh takes you gently back down to the Dream Square.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.rij: You're on a Rookguh! Forward = fly where you look, jump = up, sprint = faster, sneak = hop off. Fly through the cloud rings for the course!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.bezet: Someone is already on this Rookguh. Njeg, wait your turn!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.kwijt: Too long without a ring... the clock stopped. Start again at the first ring!
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.record: New record: %s! Vahoeg fast. (You already had today's reward.)
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.record_beloning: New record: %s! The Rookguh hiccups with pride. Here, some dream sand.
gui.guhs.vliegdroom.diploma: Your first whole course, in %s! Here's your Flying Diploma, and a little bag of dream sand. Pilot-guh worthy!
